scope: Installed B41 local action and native consumers; no external mod or runtime guarantee

readings.clock: Clock.resize scans worn items and direct character inventory for AlarmClock or AlarmClockClothing; visibility is separate from Digital tags and isDigital alarm eligibility. renderDisplay/timeDigits display GameTime. No recursive bag search, date or temperature claim.
readings.Comfrey: ISHealthPanel HApplyPoultice dispatches to ISComfreyCataplasm; perform sets ComfreyFactor. BodyPart damage update uses positive getComfreyFactor to subtract fracture time.
readings.Plantain: ISHealthPanel HApplyPoultice dispatches to ISPlantainCataplasm; perform sets PlantainFactor. BodyPart damage update uses positive getPlantainFactor to subtract scratch, cut and deep wound time.
readings.Garlic: ISHealthPanel HApplyPoultice dispatches to ISGarlicCataplasm; perform sets GarlicFactor. BodyPart damage update uses positive getGarlicFactor to reduce WoundInfectionLevel. This is wound infection, not zombification.
readings.rope: ISAddSheetRope attaches either Rope or SheetRope. Window climbing reaches ClimbThroughWindowState; it tests canClimbDownSheetRope and sets ClimbWindowOutcome=rope. Player climbwindow finishclimb.xml transitions to climbdownrope when ClimbWindowFinished and CanClimbDownRope. IsoGameCharacter registers that callback and ClimbDownSheetRopeState supplies descent. ISClimbSheetRopeAction also distinguishes ascent and descent; menu onClimbSheetRope caller passes false so descent is not inferred from that menu alone.
